_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A recording on an archived conversation starts a new one. In the diff viewer (".diff-viewer-overlay"), "the start button" is data-testid "review-record-start", "the stop button" data-testid "review-record-stop", "the cancel button" data-testid "review-record-cancel", "the status" data-testid "review-recording-status", "where" data-testid "review-recording-where" (its textContent joins its crumbs with no separator) and "said" data-testid "review-recording-said"; "the tooltip" is ".p-tooltip". "Wait for the commit message" means: wait (up to 30s) until a ".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20" is visible; the viewer opens on the repository's HEAD commit {{SHORT}}, which renames line 20 of src/app.ts to "const renamedValue = 20;". {{QUERY}} is the query string that opens the diff viewer on that commit in the repository. "It is sent" means data-testid "review-recording-sent" becomes visible (wait up to 30s: sending takes several requests). "Wait for the clock to start" means: wait until the time element of the stop button no longer reads "00:00" (eval document.querySelector("[data-testid=review-record-stop] time")?.textContent !== "00:00", expect true). There is an archived conversation /c/archived in the repository. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/archived?{{QUERY}} and wait for the commit message.
2. Hover the start button; the tooltip's text should be exactly "Record a narrated review for a new conversation".
3. Click the start button, wait for the clock to start, then click the stop button. It is sent.
4. Call "check send" should return exactly "ok": it checks that exactly one chat request was made, to a conversation other than the archived one, which the server has as not a draft, in the repository, and not archived. It makes {{NEW_ID}} that conversation's id.
5. ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='{{NEW_ID}}']" should have class "active" (eval classList.contains("active"), expect true).
